name: Itan ~Fuminijirareta Hokori~
original_name: 異端～踏み躙られた誇り～
source:
Humans and elves live in their respective territories after the Great War. Humans find devices that neutralize elven magic and capture all the elves in the hideout. From then on the history of violation and torture begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大战结束后，人类和精灵生活在各自的领地上。人类找到了可以中和精灵魔法的装置并捕获了藏身处中的所有精灵。从此开始了侵犯和酷刑的历史。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
